Design beautiful maps, colorful environments, realistic lighting, smooth animations, and engaging sound effects. Add multiple levels, coins, rewards, and character upgrades. Make the game fun, creative, and enjoyable for players. Mobile-friendly controls, optimized performance, and a polished 3D cartoon style.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable colorful 3D cartoon monster adventure game with exploration, challenges, treasures, enemies, power-ups, boss battles, multiple levels, upgrades, sound, mobile controls, and optimized performance.

## Requirements
- Build immediately without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Include smooth movement, running, jumping, flying/gliding, special monster abilities, maps, colorful environments, lighting, animation, sound effects, coins, rewards, upgrades, and boss battles.
- Support mobile-friendly controls and polished 3D cartoon presentation.
- Verify using screenshots saved as small JPEGs; latest screenshot was saved to `screenshots/mythling.jpg`.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as a single self-contained static `index.html` using Three.js from a CDN.
- Created an original cute dragon game titled “Mythling — Sky Isles Adventure.”
- Used procedural Three.js geometry instead of external 3D assets.
- Added three themed progression areas: `SUNSPROUT MEADOW`, `SUGARGLASS CANYON`, and `MOONBLOOM GROVE`.
- Added keyboard controls plus touch/mobile controls.
- Added a start modal, HUD, progress bar, boss bar, sound toggle, toast notifications, and restart/win states.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full playable game in `index.html`.
- Added procedural floating-island world, platforms, clouds, trees, mushrooms, flowers, crystals, rainbow gate, and moonflower temple.
- Added controllable dragon with movement, jumping, gliding, puff-blast ability, animation, shadows, fog, lighting, and camera follow.
- Added coins, treasure chests, enemy puffbugs, boss Grumble the Goo, health, checkpoints, death/restart flow, win state, and upgrade scaling.
- Added responsive desktop/mobile HUD and touch controls.
- Added audio tones via Web Audio API and sound toggle.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Verified `http://localhost:3002` loads and the game can start in Playwright.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/mythling.jpg`.
- Extracted the module script and passed `node --check`.
- Added favicon data URL to eliminate the previous favicon 404.

### Active
- No active implementation work; game is currently in a playable state after the last syntax check and browser reload.

### Blocked
- Browser console showed only WebGL SwiftShader/GPU stall warnings during screenshot capture; no game runtime errors were observed.
- No formal automated gameplay test suite exists.

## Next Move
1. Optionally run another browser smoke test covering start, movement, jump, blast, and mobile viewport.
2. Optionally capture a final latest JPEG after the favicon and final movement changes.
3. Review `git status --short`; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation, styling, UI, Three.js scene, controls, gameplay, audio, and progression.
- `screenshots/mythling.jpg`: Latest visual verification screenshot.
- `start.sh`: Existing project start wrapper.
- `capture.sh`: Existing project capture wrapper.
- `README.md`: Project metadata and links.

## Important Context
- The game is served as a static HTML app and does not require a package manifest or build step.
- Three.js is loaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js`.
- Local test server used: `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The last code validation command was `node --check /tmp/mythling.js`, generated from the module script in `index.html`, and it passed.
- Current repository changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `index.html` plus existing untracked project files.
